title: The Convict
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'The Convict,' office characters interact with Martin, a new employee with a criminal past, leading to discussions about stereotypes, trust, and perceptions of prison life. Michael humorously impersonates Prison Mike to illustrate prison dangers, while Dwight expresses strong disapproval of Martin's presence, regardless of race. The episode explores themes of stereotypes, trust, and the impact of past crimes on workplace relationships.
